lessons.title: Qantas to outsource 850 local jobs with most roles moving to India
lessons.title_zh: 澳洲航空將外包850個在地職位，多數職缺移往印度

paragraphs.en: Qantas plans to outsource 850 corporate positions in Australia to consulting giant Accenture. Most of these jobs will move to India, while a few will remain in Australia. The airline is speeding up its investment in artificial intelligence (AI) to update its systems.
paragraphs.zh: 澳洲航空（Qantas）計畫將澳洲境內的850個企業職位外包給顧問巨頭埃森哲（Accenture）。這些職缺大部分將移往印度，少數則會留在澳洲。該航空公司正加快對人工智慧（AI）的投資，以更新其系統。

paragraphs.en: The staff reduction will start in the middle of 2027. Positions in finance, purchasing, human resources, and marketing are scheduled to shift overseas. In a message sent to employees, chief executive officer (CEO) Vanessa Hudson acknowledged that "this is hard news for some" and apologized for the uncertainty.
paragraphs.zh: 這項裁員將於2027年年中展開。財務、採購、人資與行銷等職位預計將移往海外。執行長（CEO）凡妮莎·哈德森（Vanessa Hudson）在給員工的內部訊息中坦言「這對某些人來說是個艱難的消息」，並對此帶來的不確定性表示歉意。

paragraphs.en: According to Hudson, the rapid pace of modern technological development is completely unprecedented. Qantas currently spends more than one billion Australian dollars each year on technology. However, it still depends on over 1,000 outdated computer applications from an earlier period that were never designed to cooperate with one another.
paragraphs.zh: 哈德森表示，現代科技發展的飛快速度完全是前所未見的。澳航目前每年在科技上花費超過十億澳幣。然而，該公司仍然依賴一千多個來自過去時代的過時電腦應用程式，這些程式當初從未被設計成能夠彼此互相協同運作。

paragraphs.en: By partnering with Accenture, the airline hopes to simplify corporate tasks, cut repetitive work, and boost operational efficiency. Over time, the tasks handled by Accenture will incorporate even more automation and AI tools. Hudson noted that these adjustments would allow workers to concentrate on duties that bring genuine value to customers and business operations.
paragraphs.zh: 透過與埃森哲合作，該航空公司希望簡化企業運作、減少重複性工作，並提升營運效率。隨著時間推移，由埃森哲接手的工作將引進更多自動化與人工智慧工具。哈德森指出，這些調整將使員工能夠專注於為顧客與企業營運帶來真實價值的工作。

paragraphs.en: This major transition follows a recent market announcement regarding flight reductions and higher ticket prices caused by rising fuel expenses. Qantas stated that affected employees will be reassigned to other positions whenever possible, including new roles in Australia. The company currently employs roughly 28,000 workers in Australia and 4,000 internationally, and it is discussing these plans with labor unions.
paragraphs.zh: 這項重大轉變是在該公司近期發布市場最新消息之後所推動的，該消息指出因燃油成本上漲而將減少航班並調漲機票價格。澳航表示，受影響的員工只要可能都會被重新調派至其他職位，包括澳洲境內的新工作。該公司目前在澳洲僱用約28,000名員工，在國際上另有4,000名員工，目前正與工會就這些計畫進行討論。

vocab.zh: 前所未有的；史無前例的

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 不定詞片語 to update its systems 作為副詞，用來修飾主要子句的動作，說明加快投資的目的是「為了更新系統」。
grammar.example: The airline is speeding up its investment in artificial intelligence (AI) to update its systems.

grammar.point: 關係代名詞引導的形容詞子句 (Relative Clause with Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 關係代名詞 that 在子句中擔任主詞，引導形容詞子句修飾前面的先行詞 1,000 outdated computer applications。
grammar.example: However, it still depends on over 1,000 outdated computer applications from an earlier period that were never designed to cooperate with one another.
grammar.focus: that were never designed to cooperate with one another

grammar.explain: 由助動詞 will 與「be + 過去分詞 (reassigned)」構成未來式被動語態，表示員工將「被重新分派」到其他職務。
grammar.example: Qantas stated that affected employees will be reassigned to other positions whenever possible, including new roles in Australia.
